title: ChatGPT Custom GPT sharing can be a public page
description:
A Custom GPT set to Anyone with the link is a page a stranger can open. Open My GPTs, click Share, and look at the selected row. Switch it to Only me if you handed that link to a client last year.

Source: https://help.openai.com/articles/8798878
